name: Longmont Open 2026
information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back to Longmont for another day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcHB0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--681018add857b2b9ddfd57914855080eeb87357a/Colorado%20Cubers%20Logo%20NT.png)

This competition has a 110 competitor limit.
Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. 
If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 7:45 AM.
If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (11:59 PM  06-07-2026 MT)
This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!
